decks.notes: This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief while quickly deploying threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to apply pressure. The deck also utilizes disruptive cards like Tourach, Dread Cantor and Dauthi Voidwalker to control the board and keep the opponent on the back foot. With a mix of removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt, as well as graveyard recursion options like Undying Evil and Malakir Rebirth, this deck aims to win fast and decisively through a combination of aggression and disruption.

This deck focuses on quickly getting out large creatures using Cascade effects to overwhelm the opponent. By casting spells with Cascade like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent, the deck is able to cheat out powerful threats like Scion of Draco and Crashing Footfalls. The deck also utilizes efficient removal and disruption spells like Fire / Ice and Force of Negation to help control the board and protect its creatures. With a mix of aggressive plays and disruptive elements, this deck aims to quickly build a dominant board presence and secure the win.

The deck revolves around assembling a combo involving Underworld Breach, Grinding Station, and Urza's Saga to generate infinite mana and mill the opponent's deck. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble help with card draw and recursion. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Lightning Bolt provide alternate win conditions and disruption. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion allows for additional mana fixing. The deck aims to quickly set up its combo pieces while disrupting the opponent's game plan to secure the win.

The deck focuses on building up a powerful creature with hexproof by attaching auras to it such as Rancor and Daybreak Coronet. With cards like Slippery Bogle and Gladecover Scout providing hexproof and evasion, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a high-powered, evasive threat. The inclusion of cards like Mana Tithe offers a form of disruption against opponents looking to remove the hexproof creature. Overall, the deck is geared towards aggressively buffing up a single creature and protecting it from removal.

The core idea of this deck is to assemble the combo of equipping Colossus Hammer onto a creature, such as Ornithopter or Gingerbrute, and attacking for lethal damage in one turn. The deck utilizes various synergies and tools like Puresteel Paladin, Stoneforge Mystic, and Sigarda's Aid to efficiently equip the hammer and protect the equipped creature. Urza's Saga is included to search for key pieces of the combo, while cards like Esper Sentinel provide disruption and card advantage. The overall strategy is to quickly assemble the combo and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful, efficient attack.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a combination of fast creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker, disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Terminate, and graveyard recursion with cards like Malakir Rebirth and Undying Evil. The deck aims to control the game early on with hand disruption while building up board presence with hard-hitting creatures. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Kolaghan's Command also allows for flexibility and adaptability in different matchups. Overall, this Rakdos Aggro deck seeks to overwhelm opponents quickly and efficiently.

This deck focuses on leveraging the Cascade mechanic to cast powerful spells for free, such as Crashing Footfalls and Violent Outburst. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Blood Moon to manipulate the board state, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. The inclusion of Brazen Borrower and Force of Negation provides additional flexibility and protection. Overall, the deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent through efficient use of resources and powerful tempo plays.

This deck focuses on assembling powerful combos using equipment like Colossus Hammer and Kaldra Compleat to quickly take down opponents. Cards like Puresteel Paladin and Sigarda's Aid help to make equipping these artifacts easier and more efficient. Urza's Saga provides additional value by searching for key pieces, while disruptive elements like Esper Sentinel and Spell Pierce help to control the game and protect your threats. The deck aims to quickly set up a lethal threat and overwhelm opponents before they have a chance to react.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive Eldrazi creatures and disrupting opponents with control elements like Chalice of the Void and Karn, the Great Creator. It utilizes the Urza lands to quickly ramp into powerful threats like Thought-Knot Seer and Reality Smasher. The deck also has access to versatile cards like Warping Wail and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to deal with a variety of threats. By combining aggressive creatures with disruptive elements, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and efficiently, putting pressure on them from the early game onwards.

The deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay with a mix of disruption and evasion tactics. It aims to control the board early on with Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Terminate while deploying threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply pressure. The inclusion of cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger help to keep up with card advantage and provide additional win conditions. Mishra's Bauble and Dauthi Voidwalker offer card selection and disruption, while Blackcleave Cliffs and Blood Moon help to fix mana and disrupt opponent's mana base.

This deck focuses on casting cheap Cascade spells to put pressure on the opponent early in the game. By playing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, you can quickly put powerful spells into play without paying their mana cost. The deck combines elements of aggression with control, using cards like Leyline Binding and Force of Negation to disrupt your opponent's strategy while maintaining pressure on the board. The goal is to overwhelm your opponent with a flurry of spells and creatures, taking advantage of the Cascade mechanic to gain a significant advantage in the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing equipment cards like Colossus Hammer and Kaldra Compleat to quickly power up creatures and deal massive damage to opponents. By combining Puresteel Paladin's ability to draw cards with Sigarda's Aid and Stoneforge Mystic's ability to search for equipment, the deck is able to set up powerful combos and overwhelm opponents. Urza's Saga provides additional value by tutoring for artifacts, while cards like Spell Pierce and Giver of Runes help protect key pieces of the combo. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game before opponents have a chance to respond.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a mix of hand disruption, removal spells, and powerful creatures. The key strategy is to quickly deploy threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer while disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize. Utilizing cards like Grief and Terminate to control the board, and cards like Undying Malice and Feign Death to protect your creatures. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger adds additional disruption and pressure to the opponent, creating a fast-paced and overwhelming aggro strategy.

This deck centers around utilizing cards like Indomitable Creativity and Bitter Reunion to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty on to the battlefield. The deck uses a combination of efficient removal spells, land ramp, and card draw to set up the combo pieces and protect the combo. The deck aims to create explosive turns where it can suddenly overwhelm the opponent with its powerful creatures and win the game in a single turn. By utilizing creative combos and efficient spells, this deck aims to surprise and outpace the opponent in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.
